title: Instrument shopping list file and document boundaries
description: Add structured debug logs to shopping-list file IO and document parsing choke points, including discovery, read/write, folder resolution, and markdown document initialization summaries.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingListFiles.discover(in:)` logs entry with folder URL and exit with discovered markdown file count.
`ShoppingListFiles.readText(from:)` and `writeText(_:to:)` log entry/exit with public file paths and non-sensitive result details.
`ShoppingListFiles.shoppingListsURL(in:)` logs first-use resolution describing whether the subfolder existed or was created.
`ShoppingListDocument.init(markdown:)` emits a debug summary of parsed aisles/items and notes/meals presence without logging full content.
